mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the GDP growth declines over two consecutive quarters, or if the correlation between GDP decline and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in retail sales signal a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates increased economic activity.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and RSAFS decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint behavior of HOUST and RSAFS does not show a statistically significant correlation with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased employment supports consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over three consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates monetary tightening and reduced consumer purchasing power.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the CPI increases over three consecutive months, or if the correlation between CPI increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate signals a weakening consumer demand environment, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as reduced spending power impacts corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases and UNRATE increases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint behavior of RSAFS and UNRATE does not show a statistically significant correlation with negative returns (p > 0.05).
